scientific_integrity: The theorem follows from explicit all-size combinatorial/TP2 proof; finite exact checks are corroborative rather than certification.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric two-color Pólya model with fixed n>=2 and positive real concentration; no statement for asymmetric urns or more colors.
The universal paired-runs identity is for any exchangeable binary sequence; strong MLR is proved only in the symmetric Pólya family.
Exact run distributions and classical TP2 mechanisms may permit earlier implicit proofs; priority not independently confirmed.
title: Strict likelihood-ratio ordering with paired plateaus for Pólya-urn total runs
